description: Form-ready map location picker for the web: pan a map under a fixed pin to get lat/lng (and an address). A <location-picker> web component and a LocationPicker class; OpenStreetMap with no API key, Google Maps, MapLibre.
rules: Load v3 with <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/location-picker@3"></script>; the unpinned /dist/location-picker.min.js URL is the frozen v1 file (global locationPicker, Google only).
import 'location-picker' defines the <location-picker> element; location-picker/core is the side-effect-free class only.
Coordinates are latitude first: "lat,lng" strings or { lat, lng } objects. Arrays are rejected.
In forms use name, lat-name/lng-name, or lat-input/lng-input for existing inputs. Put required on <location-picker>, never on hidden inputs.
In frameworks bind value (a "lat,lng" string) and listen to change or input. The lat/lng attributes only set the initial value.
Read the result from value, valueAsLatLng or the change event detail, not getMarkerPosition(), which returns the view centre while unset.
OpenStreetMap needs no key. Google Maps is used only with provider="google", api-key, map-id or marker="advanced".
React 19: use onChange/onInput and lowercase onaddresschange/onready/onerror. After hydrateRoot, set object props and native listeners in a ref callback.
Search uses Photon on Leaflet/MapLibre and PlaceAutocompleteElement on Google; never show Google results on a non-Google map.
Errors are LocationPickerError objects with a stable code and a one-line fix; follow the Fix: text in the console message.
